info.title: OLIP 2.0-draft lifecycle API
info.description: PROPOSED draft. Not adopted by any standards body and not approved by any bar or regulator. OLIP 1.0 is unchanged and frozen. This file is generated from the reference host's route table. Mock-only test hooks (/mock/v2/*) are deliberately left out: a real host must never expose them.

bearer.description: Tokens identify one caller kind: user (session), agent (delegated by one user), firm (organization client credentials) or observer. x-olip-callers on each operation lists who may call it.

get.summary: Same as capabilities, at a well-known path.

post.summary: OAuth2-style token endpoint (mock client credentials and delegation codes).
User sign-in (mock password; a real host uses its own OIDC sign-in).

password.description: Mock only. A real host uses its own OpenID Connect sign-in.

post.summary: The USER lets one assistant act for them. Content access is off unless the user turns it on.
